facts.fact: 对峙开场：他把她 ch29 的「Funny—I could say the same」原样奉还——「You don't get to use my words. Choose your own」；「you said you wouldn't fuck me if our men were downstairs」——她敢说、他呛咳
facts.anchor: “Funny. I could say the same.” He repeats my words now.

facts.fact: 她的自白：夜里想象过他的手（他听见过）——「Serves you right for listening in. Hopefully you suffered」——「Willing target」
facts.anchor: I imagined your hands on me.

facts.fact: 许可问句：这个被她「骚扰」过的男人要先问「May I see you?」——她答「I love you, Draven. You can have anything you want. I chose to share every part of my existence with you」/他回「I love you, Lavina. I live for you」；反锁门（「I wouldn't want anyone walking in」）+「my Vina Viper」
facts.anchor: wants to know if he has my permission?

facts.fact: 独特的顾虑：她的愈合血赋会让处女膜在过程中复原——「What if you repeatedly heal?」——她的方案「Then don't be fast. Let me heal around you」；他「This could work」
结合时的低语：「我知道你珍视我们的印记，但我更感激你先选了我这个人」；快进快出不磨蹭——「Move」是她给的唯一指令
facts.anchor: I know you value our marks, but I’m beholden you chose me as a man first.

facts.fact: 事后趣闻：他要给 tonics——她已经吃了十多年（Areneas 的 Noxari 调剂、防「被掳走」的保险）；他的愧疚「I'm immensely sorry it took me so long to find you」——她纠正「I ascended for the people I love…including you before you even knew it. Not because I needed to survive while I waited for you」
facts.anchor: I had to have reassurance in case I was ever…taken.

facts.fact: 收束：他「I see you. I love everything you are and anything you will become」——她「I think I'm going to keep you, Draven Artrayu.」——他一个词「Please.」
facts.anchor: I think I’m going to keep you, Draven Artrayu.”
